integrity: The finite assertions follow from fully enumerated bijective point-line matchings and symmetric-difference cycles, checked with two independent standalone Python constructions; no probabilistic inference or unchecked external data.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite calculation for the Pappus graph only; neither an infinite-family claim nor a claim of novelty for the elementary permutation-parity invariant or for the matching count alone. Historical equivalence in unindexed toroidal-dimer literature is possible.
title: Hexagon parity and octagon mobility in Pappus perfect matchings
